# Renesas RX, GNU syntax, against rx-elf-as (binutils 2.47, default CPU).
# One statement per line. Code lands in section P, which the harness extracts.

# ---- no operands
brk
dbt

nop

# ---- registers, case, and statement syntax
mov r0, r15
mov r15, r0
MOV R1, R2
Mov.L r3, r4
nop ! nop
nop ; a comment
